language.notice.body: Every language other than English was translated automatically, with no human proofreading. Wording may be clumsy or plainly wrong.

onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to ReView
onboarding.welcome.body: Your collaborative review space: video, image, 3D and splats, with time-stamped annotations, boards and kanban.
onboarding.keyboard.title: Everything from the keyboard
onboarding.keyboard.body: Ctrl+K opens the command palette to go anywhere. “g” then p/k/b jumps to projects, kanban or board.
onboarding.review.title: Reviewing a media
onboarding.review.body: Open a media to annotate frame by frame, compare versions (A/B), and leave comments anchored to the exact frame.
onboarding.personalise.title: Make it yours
onboarding.personalise.body: Pin your projects with a right-click, save list views, and adjust theme, density and language in your profile.
onboarding.help.title: Need a hand?
onboarding.help.body: Press “?” for the list of shortcuts (all reconfigurable), and find the full guide under Documentation.

shotgrid.site.patStep2: Generate a Personal Access Token from the Autodesk profile page.
shotgrid.site.patStep3: Paste that token into the Token Code field of the site and bind it.
shotgrid.matrix.readOnlyHint: ReView never redefines this reference data in ShotGrid.

shotgrid.settings.lookbackHint: Must cover the longest outage you want to survive.
shotgrid.settings.autoImportHint: Every new ShotGrid version with media lands in ReView, ready to review.
shotgrid.settings.mediaSourceHint: The transcoded file is lighter; the original is heavier but untouched.

retention.title: Log retention
retention.intro: How long the studio keeps each journal before it is deleted automatically. 0 means keep for ever.
retention.hint.deadOnly: Only expired or revoked entries, and only once dead this long.
retention.conflictNote: A ShotGrid sync run still holding an unresolved conflict is never deleted.
retention.hint.batchSize: Deletions run in capped batches so the database stays responsive during a sweep.
retention.runTruncated: Batch ceiling reached — the nightly sweep will carry on.
